clauses.text: Policy POL-001 is in force from 2026-01-01 to 2026-12-31.
Covered perils: theft, fire, water damage, collision.
Excluded: wear and tear, gradual deterioration, and rust.
Excluded: intentional damage or acts committed by the policyholder.
Excluded: loss while property is used for commercial rental or business.
Maximum payable per claim is 10000 less a deductible of 500.
Loss must be reported to the insurer within 30 days of the date of loss.
Theft claims require an invoice and a police report.
Collision claims require an invoice, a police report and a photo report.
Water damage claims require an invoice.
